sentence_stem: Because the survey results were unclear,
full_sentence: Because the survey results were unclear, the researchers repeated the experiment.
acceptable_variants: the researchers decided to run the experiment again.
the team repeated the data collection.

options.text: the researchers ignored the data entirely.
options.why_wrong: Ignoring the data is not a logical response to unclear results, so the 'because' clause does not lead to it.

options.text: the report was published last year.
options.why_wrong: This is a fact about publication that has no logical link to the reason given in the stem.

options.text: the journal printed the results in color.
options.why_wrong: This describes a printing detail, which has no cause-and-effect link to the unclear results.

explanation: 'Because' introduces a clause of reason, so the completion must describe a logical result of the unclear survey results. Repeating the experiment is a sensible consequence of unclear results.
translation: Anket sonuçları belirsiz olduğu için araştırmacılar deneyi tekrarladı.
